text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain Duty Free plans to raise its capital to two million dinars from 1.5 million by offering shares.
- The General Committee for Bahrain Workers urges a wage increase for private sector workers.
- Hotels in Bahrain witnessed a 31 percent rise in business in six months.
- Bahrain-Egypt trade ties need boost, Egyptian ambassador says.
- Taib Bank posts a $5.3 million net profit, up 10 percent from a year earlier.
- Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company posts a 336,420 dinar net profit in the first half of 1997.
- Crown Prince affirms strong relations with the United States, praises U.S. role in maintaining security and stability of the region.
- Ministry of Labour has secured more than 5,000 jobs for Bahrainis in a year.
- Net profit of Bahraini Saudi Bank rises to 1.8 million dinars in the first six months of 1997 from 1.6 million dinars a year earlier.
